title: Assets
lead: Your fixed assets with the depreciation schedule per year.
loadError: The assets could not be loaded.
emptyDescription: An asset is created from a booked expense that carries the asset flag.
unverifiedNote: For a small business owner the limits for low value assets (800 EUR), the pool (250 to 1,000 EUR) and the immediate expense (250 EUR) are applied to the gross price. This reading is not verified. Check it with your tax adviser.
bookValueMissing: The list does not show a current book value. The schedule of an asset shows the book value of every year.

detail.loadError: The asset could not be loaded.
detail.imported: This asset was imported with an opening book value.

editBlocked.yearEnded: The first year of the schedule has ended. The asset can no longer be edited, because a figure of that year may be in a filed tax return. Record a disposal for a later change.
editBlocked.disposed: The asset is disposed and can no longer be edited.

form.expenseHint: Booked expenses with the asset flag. An expense that is an asset already is not listed.
form.expensesFailed: The expenses could not be loaded.
form.noExpenses: No booked expense with the asset flag in this year.
form.regimeNote: The cost is proposed from the expense. Check it, the server verifies it.
form.name: Name
form.costHint: For example 1499.00. The server checks the amount against the expense.
form.usefulLifeHint: Entered by you. Required for the linear method.
form.linkedExpense: This asset is linked to a booked expense. The link stays as it is.
form.saveError: The asset could not be saved. Check the marked fields.
form.conflictEdit: The asset can no longer be edited, or the new date lies in a year that has ended. Record a disposal for a later change.
form.expenseTaken: An asset exists for this expense already.

disposal.title: Record a disposal
disposal.message: The asset leaves the register on this date. A disposal cannot be undone.
disposal.disposedOnHint: Format 2026-12-01. A date in a year that has ended is refused.
disposal.conflict: The disposal was refused: the asset is disposed already, or the date lies in a year that has ended.
disposal.error: The disposal could not be recorded. Check the marked field.

reasons.future: The date must not be in the future.
reasons.notAsset: The expense must carry the asset flag.
reasons.storno: A storno row cannot become an asset.
reasons.noBasis: The amounts of the expense do not give a cost basis.
reasons.positive: The amount must be greater than 0.
reasons.badUsefulLife: Enter a whole number of months.
reasons.immediateLimit: An immediate expense is allowed up to 250.00 EUR.
reasons.gwgLimit: A low value asset is allowed up to 800.00 EUR.
reasons.poolRange: A pool item costs more than 250.00 EUR and at most 1,000.00 EUR.
reasons.linearOnly: A useful life belongs to the linear method only.
reasons.usefulLifeRequired: The linear method needs a useful life from 1 to 600 months.
reasons.openingTogether: The opening book value and its year go together.
reasons.openingYearFuture: The opening year must not be after the current year.
reasons.openingYearEarly: The opening year must be after the year of acquisition.
reasons.openingRange: The opening book value must be from 0 to the cost basis.
reasons.openingZero: The opening book value must be 0 for this method and year.
reasons.beforeAcquired: The date must not be before the acquisition.
reasons.beforeOpening: The date must not be before the opening year.
reasons.negative: The value must not be negative.
reasons.regimeMissing: No VAT regime period covers the payment date of the expense.
reasons.basisMismatch: The cost basis of this expense is {amount} ({regime}).
